alternativeSelection.assessment: Threeconcepts pass sequentially fromsubstantialpsychological theory, empiricalmethods andspecificapplications. Broadpsychology retains developmental,clinical,social,cognitive andorganisationalstudy. Cognition/mindadds genuine neural,computational andphilosophicaltools; work/organisationsadds directleadership/emotion-regulation/negotiation andspecificinstitutional contexts. Both are qualitativelydistinct andexceed30ECfloor. Clinical andeducationcandidates remain recordedmaximum-reached onlyafter threevalidprogrammes.

notes.text: The Erasmus curriculum includes specialist psychological assessment, psychometrics, professional skills and a required 14-EC thesis. These UCR programmes offer related academic study and do not establish the same specialist preparation or automatic access to a particular master’s programme.

audience.programmeDescription: Psychology at Erasmus University Rotterdam studies behaviour, emotion, development and cognition through psychological theory, research methods and practical training. The pathway shown continues through Brain & Cognition after the shared core.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers a broad psychology programme and two related options focusing on cognition and mind, or psychology and organisations. They share substantial psychological inquiry with Erasmus, while adding other disciplines. Dedicated psychometrics, specialist professional training and the compulsory 14-EC thesis are not reproduced.

curriculum.limitation: The 180 EC include a 15-EC approved minor and two programme-offered psychology electives of 5 EC each. Erasmus also requires test-subject hours without EC. Lectures are in English; the Dutch track uses Dutch tutorials and examinations.

componentNotes.psy-elective: 10 EC of psychology profiling: two programme-offered 5-EC electives, one five-week and one nine-week course; places may be limited.
componentNotes.psy-minor: 15 EC of approved minor or exchange space.
componentNotes.psy-thesis: Required 14-EC thesis. Optional UCR independent research is additional and unscheduled.
